title: SHERLOC: Structured Diagnostic Localization for Code Repair Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.24820v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents solve repository-level coding tasks through multi-turn tool use, but utilize half their budget on locating faults before editing. Dedicated localization frameworks have emerged, yet are still evaluated as file retrieval rather than actionable diagnosis, producing locations without the diagnostic context a repair agent needs. We introduce SHERLOC (Structured Hypothesis-driven Exploration and Reasoning for Localization), a training-free framework pairing a reasoning LLM with compact repository tools and self-recovery, without fine-tuning or multi-agent orchestration. SHERLOC reaches state-of-the-art localization across model scales: 84.33% accuracy@1 on SWE-Bench Lite and 81.27% recall@1 on SWE-Bench Verified; at ~30B parameters, it matches or outperforms other agentic methods. Injecting our locations and diagnostic findings into repair agents yields an average +5.95 pp resolve-rate gain from the best SHERLOC result per sett

translated_title: SHERLOC：面向代码修复代理的结构化诊断定位
translated_abstract: LLM智能体通过多轮工具调用解决仓库级编程任务，但在编辑之前会消耗一半的预算用于定位故障。专门的定位框架已经出现，但它们仍被评估为文件检索而非可操作的诊断，产生的位置信息缺乏修复代理所需的诊断上下文。我们提出SHERLOC（结构化假设驱动的探索与推理定位），这是一个无需训练的框架，将推理型LLM与轻量级仓库工具和自我恢复机制相结合，无需微调或多智能体编排。SHERLOC在各个模型规模上都达到了最先进的定位性能：在SWE-Bench Lite上达到84.33%的accuracy@1，在SWE-Bench Verified上达到81.27%的recall@1；在约300亿参数规模下，它与其他智能体方法相当甚至更优。将我们的定位结果和诊断发现注入修复代理后，在每种设置下采用最佳SHERLOC结果平均带来+5.95个百分点的解决率提升。
tldr: SHERLOC是一个无需训练的结构化假设驱动定位框架，通过将推理型LLM与轻量级仓库工具相结合实现仓库级故障的最先进诊断定位，并将诊断结果注入修复代理后平均提升5.95个百分点的解决率。
en_tdlr: SHERLOC is a training-free, hypothesis-driven localization framework that pairs a reasoning LLM with compact repository tools to achieve state-of-the-art fault diagnosis for repository-level coding tasks, boosting repair agents' resolve rates by an average of 5.95 percentage points.
